# setflowctrl

Causes Tera Term to change flow control. *(version 4.94 or later)*

```ttl
setflowctrl <value>
```

## Parameters

**integer &lt;value&gt;**

Set the flow control of serial port by using below flags. Value Meaning 1 Xon/Xoff 2 hardware(RTS/CTS) 3 none 4 hardware(DSR/DTR) *(version 4.105 or later)*

## Example

```ttl
; change flow control to "none"
setflowctrl 3
```
